COD.rationale: Content (red coordinates), presentation/access marker (current), and a separate origin/status field are all explicitly present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation statement linking processing to the listed contents.

C.rationale: The text identifies represented content (red) with explicit coordinates for a named referent and time.

D.rationale: An origin/status field is separately attributed to the same identified content, distinguishing identity from its provenance/access status.

O.rationale: The entries label items as 'current' and 'candidate' and present content in named structured slots, indicating presentation/access state.
